name: Phantom Armor Tetra ~Micchaku Suit ni Suberikomu Shokushu to Hakudaku Eki no Kyoufu!~
original_name: 霊甲テトラ ～密着スーツにスベり込むッ触手と白濁液の恐怖！～
source:
Alien Glams military group invaded the city, and 70% of the city citizens fell into Glams group's hand.
City population fell down to half. Meanwhile, miss Neon, a genius scientist from Linger The Earth Resistance group, came up with an ultimate weapon that is effective to this particular creature on the earth.
It is the super powered humanoid Tetra!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE046454.html]DLsite English[/url]]
